artefact: This manual is for Aralia field technicians who install and service Aralia POS Cloud hardware in merchant stores. It covers the store network, receipt printers, cash drawers, kitchen display screens, the Sunmi T2s all-in-one terminal and spare parts.
search_text: This manual is for Aralia field technicians who install and service Aralia POS Cloud hardware in merchant stores. It covers the store network, receipt printers, cash drawers, kitchen display screens, the Sunmi T2s all-in-one terminal and spare parts.

artefact: Switch off and unplug a printer before opening its cover or touching the print head. The print head stays hot for several minutes after printing. Never connect a telephone line to a cash drawer port; the drawer port carries 24 V.
search_text: Switch off and unplug a printer before opening its cover or touching the print head. The print head stays hot for several minutes after printing. Never connect a telephone line to a cash drawer port; the drawer port carries 24 V.

artefact: Each store needs a stable connection with at least 2 Mbps of bandwidth. POS devices sit on their own VLAN, separate from guest Wi-Fi. Printers and kitchen display screens use fixed IP addresses. No inbound ports are needed.
search_text: Each store needs a stable connection with at least 2 Mbps of bandwidth. POS devices sit on their own VLAN, separate from guest Wi-Fi. Printers and kitchen display screens use fixed IP addresses. No inbound ports are needed.

artefact: Two receipt printers are supported. Figure 2 and Figure 3 show the rear panels of the two models. Check which model you have before connecting the cash drawer: the drawer port and the power supply differ between them.
search_text: Two receipt printers are supported. Figure 2 and Figure 3 show the rear panels of the two models. Check which model you have before connecting the cash drawer: the drawer port and the power supply differ between them.

artefact: The cash drawer opens when the printer sends a kick pulse through the drawer cable. Use only the Aralia drawer cables; telephone cables have a different pin order.
search_text: The cash drawer opens when the printer sends a kick pulse through the drawer cable. Use only the Aralia drawer cables; telephone cables have a different pin order.

artefact: The status light on the front of a receipt printer shows its state. The table continues on the next page.

artefact: Kitchen display screens (KDS) show orders to kitchen staff. Mount the screen away from heat and steam, at eye level for the cooks.
search_text: Kitchen display screens (KDS) show orders to kitchen staff. Mount the screen away from heat and steam, at eye level for the cooks.

artefact: The Sunmi T2s combines a till screen and a printer. Field technicians may replace the parts shown in Figure 6; return any other fault to the depot.

artefact: Before leaving, print a test receipt, open the cash drawer from the till, place a test order on the KDS, and ask the store manager to sign the job sheet in the technician app.

artefact: The Aralia Pay R2 takes chip, tap and phone payments and connects to the till over Bluetooth. It works only with Aralia POS Cloud.
search_text: The Aralia Pay R2 takes chip, tap and phone payments and connects to the till over Bluetooth. It works only with Aralia POS Cloud.

artefact: Pair each reader with one till. The pairing code appears on the till screen.
search_text: Pair each reader with one till. The pairing code appears on the till screen.

artefact: Charge the R2 with the supplied USB-C cable. A full charge lasts about 8 hours of normal trading. Leave the reader on its dock overnight.
